name: Auction Draw Dominoes
description: Auction Draw Dominoes is a high-stakes gambling variant of the classic Draw Dominoes game. It introduces a chip-based economy where players pay to draw tiles from the boneyard, and most uniquely, participate in a competitive auction for the final two remaining tiles in the boneyard. The winner of the hand claims the entire accumulated chip pool.

content.text: Auction Draw Dominoes is a high-stakes gambling variant of the classic Draw Dominoes game. It introduces a chip-based economy where players pay to draw tiles from the boneyard, and most uniquely, participate in a competitive auction for the final two remaining tiles in the boneyard. The winner of the hand claims the entire accumulated chip pool.

A derivative of the standard 'Draw' domino game, adding elements of poker-style betting and auction theory. Likely developed in tavern settings where gambling on dominoes was a common pastime, and documented in English domino circles.
2-4 players. Each starts with an equal stack of chips.
2-3 players: 7 tiles each. 4 players: 6 tiles each. Remaining tiles form the 'Boneyard'.

items.text: Heavy Ante: Players contribute a larger initial amount, making the auction bid relatively less significant.
